entries.title: A task's record keeps its checks only when they change
entries.body: The app reads an open pull request's checks every five minutes, and each reading went into the task's record even when nothing had changed: one waiting pull request added 239 identical lines in a day. Now a reading is kept only when the checks change, and a task waiting on another task is not read until that work is done.
entries.noPicture: The record's checks line stops opening to hundreds of identical readings; there is no new view to show.
